start.text: Chocobar thirty, kulfi forty, cone fifty. The cone melts before you reach the bandstand - I'm warning you now so you don't come back angry.

choco.text: Good choice. Chocobar is the cone's sensible cousin.

kulfi.text: Malai. The dogs know the sound of this lid, so eat fast.

bye.text: Walk once around, you'll come back. Everyone does.
